INSERT INTO pharmacies (external_id, provider, name, postal_code, city, address, url, first_seen_at, last_seen_at)
           SELECT u.external_id, u.provider, u.name, u.postal_code, u.city, u.address, u.url, now(), now()
           FROM UNNEST($1::text[], $2::text[], $3::text[], $4::text[], $5::text[], $6::text[], $7::text[])
                AS u(external_id, provider, name, postal_code, city, address, url)
           ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE SET
               provider = EXCLUDED.provider, name = EXCLUDED.name, postal_code = EXCLUDED.postal_code, city = EXCLUDED.city,
               address = EXCLUDED.address, url = EXCLUDED.url, last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at
           RETURNING id, external_id
